concept: Design vision for: Build me a Cofi shop Website. Identity: Espresso & Cream · asymmetric 12-column editorial grid with oversized display type. A coffee shop should feel like the counter, not a template: warm ink, cream paper, one decisive caramel accent. The layout breaks its own grid on purpose (cards stagger), the type is oversized and confident, and the one signature interaction — hover-lift with a caramel sweep — is the product cards, the thing a customer actually touches.

palette.why: espresso-dark base for type: warmth without muddiness
cream ground: high contrast, no sterile white
single caramel accent for CTAs and the hover sweep
ember for hover/pressed depth of the accent
mocha for secondary text, hairlines, and the cart panel
latte for card fills and zebra surfaces

layout: asymmetric 12-column editorial grid with oversized display type; hero + bento cart panel; cards stagger vertically so the grid visibly breaks
signatureInteraction: hover-lift card: translateY(-6px) with a subtle rotate on a 200ms cubic-bezier ease-out, plus a 4px caramel accent sweep along the card's bottom edge
a11yConstraints: WCAG AA contrast (>= 4.5:1) on all body text against its background
prefers-reduced-motion guard: all transitions/animations disabled when set
aria-label on icon-only controls; aria-live region for the cart total
lang attribute on the html element
typography: serif display stack (Iowan Old Style, Georgia, Times New Roman) over the same serif for body, weight-driven hierarchy 400/700/800; display at clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5.4rem) with 1.05 leading
